name: linear
description: The notifications in your Linear inbox (assignments, mentions, comments, status changes), read through Linear's own API with a personal API key. Read-only: it only ever asks Linear a question and never marks anything as read.

secrets.name: token
secrets.help: In Linear, open Settings > Account > Security & Access, create a personal API key, give it the "Read" permission only, and paste the key (starts with lin_api_) when asked. Steps: extractors/linear/README.md. A work Linear may not let members create keys, and your employer's rules decide whether you may do this at all.
